name: Create SSL Configuration
description: Create SSL Configuration Upload a new SSL certificate for a zone. POST /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/custom_certificates
context:
POST /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/custom_certificates
Upload a new SSL certificate for a zone.
Required: zone_id (path); body (body)

name: Delete SSL Configuration
description: Delete SSL Configuration Remove a SSL certificate from a zone. DELETE /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/custom_certificates/{custom_certificate_id}

name: Edit SSL Configuration
description: Edit SSL Configuration Upload a new private key and/or PEM/CRT for the SSL certificate. PATCH /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/custom_certificates/{custom_certificate_id}

name: List SSL Configurations
description: List SSL Configurations List, search, and filter all of your custom SSL certificates. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/custom_certificates
context:
GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/custom_certificates
List, search, and filter all of your custom SSL certificates. The higher priority will break ties across overlapping 'legacy_custom' certificates, but 'legacy_custom' certificates will always supercede 'sni_custom' certificates.
Required: zone_id (path)
Optional: page (query); per_page (query); match (query); status (query)

name: Re-prioritize SSL Certificates
description: Re-prioritize SSL Certificates If a zone has multiple SSL certificates, you can set the order in which they should be used during a request. PUT /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/custom_certificates/prioritize
context:
PUT /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/custom_certificates/prioritize
If a zone has multiple SSL certificates, you can set the order in which they should be used during a request. The higher priority will break ties across overlapping 'legacy_custom' certificates.
Required: zone_id (path); body (body)

name: SSL Configuration Details
description: SSL Configuration Details Retrieves details for a specific custom SSL certificate, including certificate metadata, bundle method, geographic restrictions, and associated keyless server configuration. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/custom_certificates/{custom_certificate_id}
